# Single Holder

## Statement

Exactly one entity holds the ball at any moment; during a transfer the ball is in flight and held by no one.

## Who Feels It

The world. This is physics, not preference — no design configuration may violate it (★★ class).

## Evidence

Given by the sport. Every possession representation that allowed >1 holder produced visibly broken play.
